items.title: A delta-functor vanishing on suitable embeddings is universal
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file homology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a delta-functor which can be killed in positive degrees by embedding any object into a suitable one is universal (statement lines 2921-2930). The proof is a complete argument: the extension of a given morphism out of the degree zero part is constructed by induction, and the induction step uses an embedding whose induced map in the relevant degree is zero to identify the next value of the functor with a cokernel, from which the next component is read off as the unique map making a displayed square commute (proof lines 2933-2965). The non-formal content is the cokernel identification and the induction. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
